2026 Invitational Rules FINAL

The duration of each match is indicated below. Two equal halves will be played for all age groups.

Mercy Rule - If the score reaches a six (6) goal difference, the match ends immediately.

8. Substitutions: Substitutions shall be unlimited. Substitutions can occur at any stoppage.

11. Water breaks: A break will be given at the midpoint of each half when temperatures exceed 85 degrees.

13. Heading Guidelines: Heading is not allowed for players U12 and younger.

The Tournament Director decides in the event of inclement weather. All regular season rules apply.

Tie-Breakers: If both teams earned an equal number of points during group play, the criteria below apply.

  1. Head-to-Head
  2. Goal Differential (max 4 per game)
  3. Goals For (max 4 per game)
  4. Goals Against
  5. Shutouts
  6. Penalty Kicks (FIFA)

Championship games use the same format.
